meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major|explicit-semver>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把新版本发布到 npm 并确认发布成功
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果发布了新版本后需要确认它真正上线了
copy.tagline_en: Publish a new version to npm and confirm the release succeeded
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ship a new version and verify it went live

howto.what: 把发布交给它:它会触发 GitHub Actions 发布工作流,发布并核对 oh-my-opencode 等 npm 包、GitHub release、平台二进制包与 Discord 公告。它只管发布,不会在发布时重新审代码。
howto.when: 当你提到“publish”、“release”、“deploy”等关键词,或要求把版本发到 npm 时接管。你必须给出 patch、minor、major 或明确版本号,否则它会先停下来询问。

say.note: 触发发布工作流,并跟到五项验证全部完成。

say.text: 帮我发布 5.0.0-beta.9 这个版本
say.note: 按你给的确切版本号触发发布流程。

say.text: 把 oh-my-opencode 发成 minor 版本

howto.what_en: It acts as release manager: triggers the GitHub Actions publish workflow, then verifies npm packages, the GitHub release, platform binaries and a Discord announcement. Ship-only: it won't re-review code during a publish.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "publish", "release" or "deploy", or ask to push a version to npm. It needs a selector: patch, minor, major or an explicit version, otherwise it stops and asks.

say_en.note: Triggers the workflow and follows through to verification.
Dispatches the publish flow for that exact version.

say_en.text: Publish oh-my-opencode as a minor release
say_en.note: Creates the release, verifies npm and posts to Discord.
